correctness.rationale: From exact Rule 22 truth table, two-bit overlap relations on states 00,01,10,11 are L0=(1,8,2,12), L1=(2,4,1,0) as four bit masks. A word w repeated cyclically has a kn-periodic antecedent iff the Boolean relation R(w)^k has a loop; any periodic image word yields a directed cycle in its four-state return graph. An independent exact integer BFS from the identity, closing under both symbols without word-length cutoff, found exactly 2375 reachable relations and multiplier classes {1:2012,2:130,3:2,4:0,none:231}. The only multiplier-three-first relations are L1 and L1². Augmenting reachable relation with a flag recording an encountered zero gives 2375 augmented states and no zero-containing path with first return 3. L1 is a directed 3-cycle, proving all-one output needs factor3 precisely when 3 does not divide n; the word 001 has no 3-period antecedent but has a 6-period one. Thus uniform multiplier≤3, mixed/zero≤2, and both sharpness witnesses hold for every n, by exhaustive state closure, not a finite word cutoff.
